title: Chapter 3 Quiz 3
description: The parts of a program, in order, and how constants and procedures are written.
instructions: Take your time: read each question carefully, then check your answer.

questions.question: Put the parts of a program in the order given by the course.
questions.explanation: This is the order of the parts: types, constants, variables, subprograms, then the main program.

questions.question: Which keywords delimit the **main program**?
questions.explanation: The main program is delimited by Begin and End.

questions.question: Which line declares a constant?
questions.explanation: A constant is declared with the keyword Constant (or CONST) followed by its name and value.

questions.question: The main program can call functions and procedures.
questions.explanation: The main program is a sequence of operations that often calls functions or procedures.

questions.question: A function or procedure can itself call other functions and procedures.
What is an **output parameter** of a function?
options: A variable typed by the user
The value returned by the function
questions.explanation: An input parameter refers to a variable handled by the subprogram. An output parameter is the value the function returns.

questions.question: A {{1}} performs actions but does not return a value, while a {{2}} performs calculations and returns a value.
questions.explanation: Procedure: actions only. Function: returns a value.

questions.question: Complete the declaration of a constant and a variable.
questions.explanation: A constant receives its value with ←, and a variable is declared with As and its type.
